title: Add professional ML Explorer Shiny app (165-ml-explorer)
description:
Interactive machine learning explorer built with shinydashboard. Supports Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Linear/Logistic Regression on built-in R datasets (iris, mtcars, swiss, airquality). Features dynamic hyperparameter tuning, train/test splitting, and four dashboard tabs: Data Explorer (distributions, DT preview), Model Training (config + results + model details), Performance (accuracy/RMSE/Kappa/F1/R², confusion matrix, residual plot, predicted-vs-actual), and Visualizations (variable importance, interactive feature scatter).

https://claude.ai/code/session_01DzU8gjqGYiHY7noL4Btyux

title: fix(182-google-charts): use https
description:
This pull request updates the `182-google-charts/app.R` file to improve data accessibility and enhance security by switching to HTTPS for external resources. The most important changes include modifying the data source and updating the URL for the Google web font.

### Data Accessibility:
* Changed the data source from a local file (`healthexp.Rds`) to a remote file hosted on GitHub for easier access and version control.

### Security Enhancements:
* Updated the Google web font URL to use `HTTPS` instead of `HTTP`, ensuring secure loading of external resources.

Fixes #221

title: Make Superzip shinyloadtest-compatible
description:
063-superzip-example wasn't compatible with [shinyloadtest]() because of [this line of code in DT](https://github.com/rstudio/DT/blob/959ccd4e66f281386103e7598a8f7f13ac1fcae0/R/shiny.R#L461).

DT would provide a random default outputId, which would make recordings nondeterministic, as this random ID would be embedded in the shinyloadtest recording.

This fix supplies `DT::dataTableAjax()` an `outputId` parameter which prevents a random one from being generated. Consequently, recordings of the app can now be played back successfully.

~~I have a separate PR for DT in the works.~~
Merged DT PR: https://github.com/rstudio/DT/pull/730

title: Fix for 157-date-format: ensure inputs are rendered after test results
description:
Rendering `output$inputs` in this app has always produced JS errors (see https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/2591 for minimal example), but that wasn't a noticeable issue until https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/2429, which changed the order in which the outputs execute. Specifically, prior to https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/2429, the test results (i.e. `output$res`) were rendered before `output$input`. After https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/2429,  `output$input` now renders first, and as a result, the JS errors it produces prevents the test results from rendering.

This change ensures the test results are rendered first, but after https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/2591 is fixed, the ordering won't matter.

title: 1-line bugfix for newer versions of "tm" package > v0.60
description:
Avoid Error message  

```
" Warning in mclapply(unname(content(x)), termFreq, control) :
  all scheduled cores encountered errors in user code
Error in UseMethod("meta", x) :
  no applicable method for 'meta' applied to an object of class "character"
 "
```

The latest version of tm (0.60) made it so you can't use functions with tm_map that operate on simple character values any more. So the problem is your tolower() step since that isn't an "canonical" transformation (See getTransformations()).
see: http://stackoverflow.com/a/24771621/202553

title: Incompatibility with tm 6.0
description: Hello, there was a incompatibility issue with tm 6.0 which behaved differently from tm 5.2, leading to an error message "Error in inherits(doc, "TextDocument")". It can be fixed by converting the character string to TextDocuments before DocumentTermMatrix is called. Borrowed the solution fromhttp://stackoverflow.com/questions/24191728/documenttermmatrix-error-on-corpus-argument
